captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a combination wrench featuring a closed-loop box wrench on one end and an open-ended wrench on the other. Both ends are circular heads connected by a flat, solid rectangular handle. The box end features a clean, hexagonal cutout, while the open end has a hexagonal cutout partially sliced open by a rectangular channel to form the jaws.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, customizable combination wrench in OpenSCAD with adjustable nut size, tool height, and tool length. The wrench should feature a closed hexagonal box end on one side and an open-ended jaw on the other, connected by a rectangular handle, with optional support for custom embossed text.
captions.factory: The script constructs the wrench by first creating a solid base using a union of two cylinders at the ends and a central cube for the handle. A difference operation is then applied: a hexagon module cuts out the closed box end, while a combined hexagon and intersecting cube cut out the open-ended jaws on the opposite side. Finally, a write function is used to engrave a custom message on the handle surface.
